image_description: A close-up photograph of a green snake, identified as a Green Mamba, resting among dark green foliage. The snake's head is prominent in the foreground, displaying a yellowish-green hue that transitions to a brighter emerald green along the body. The scales appear smooth and slightly glossy. The eye is large, dark, and round. The background consists of out-of-focus leaves, creating a naturalistic setting.
